## Biographical Information

(1861-1917)

sister-in-law of [Charlotte Fortescue Yonge](person_1588.qmd)

She married (1883) [John Henry or Harry Yonge](person_2080.qmd) (1852-1934), solicitor, son of CMY's first cousin the Rev. John Eyre Yonge.
